# Dialog

A window over the page that takes attention until people finish or close it.

**In Content first.** Sign-up without leaving the page. Family: overlay. Reference: Open UX (modal), MIT.

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** People must decide or finish something before going back: a short form, an important choice.
- **Not when:** A short status (toast), extra detail on the page (accordion), or a side panel that should not block the page (sheet).

Instead:

- [Sheet](./sheet.md): A side panel; the page stays in view.
- [Toast](./toast.md): Does not interrupt.
- [Alert dialog](./alert-dialog.md): Confirms something that cannot be undone.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> elevation.overlay and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> No shadow</div></div><div class="cap">The dimmed page focuses the reader on the dialog.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape closes it. | undefined |
| undefined | Tab stays inside while it is open. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a dialog with a title; the page behind is hidden from screen readers. undefined
- [ ] Focus moves in when it opens and back to the trigger when it closes. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add dialog
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay/background` | Fill of a dialog, menu or toast. | `color.surface.raised` → `content-first.theme.light.color.surface.raised` → `color.stone.light.0` | `color.surface.raised` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.surface.raised` → `color.stone.dark.100` |
| `overlay/radius` | Corner radius of overlays. | `radius.container` → `content-first.theme.base.radius.container` → `radius.12` | same |
| `overlay/shadow` | Shadow of overlays. | `elevation.overlay` → `content-first.theme.light.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.overlay` | `elevation.overlay` → `content-first.theme.dark.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.overlay-dark` |
| `overlay/scrim` | Color that dims the page behind a dialog. | `color.surface.scrim` → `content-first.theme.light.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.light.scrim` | `color.surface.scrim` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.dark.scrim` |
| `overlay/item-height` | Height of a menu item. | `size.control.default` → `size.48` | same |
| `tooltip/background` | Tooltip fill. | `color.surface.inverse` → `content-first.theme.light.color.surface.inverse` → `color.stone.light.900` | `color.surface.inverse` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.surface.inverse` → `color.stone.dark.900` |
| `tooltip/label` | Tooltip text. | `color.text.inverse` → `content-first.theme.light.color.text.inverse` → `color.stone.light.0` | `color.text.inverse` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.text.inverse` → `color.stone.dark.50` |
